integration_issues.issue: Timeline drifts a few years before pause() commits. Observed: navigating to ?year=1440&event=tech-gutenberg rendered header as '1,457 CE' (~17y drift at default 100 yps ≈ 170ms of RAF ticking) because useTimeline initializes with playing=true and RAF starts ticking before App parse-URL effect fires setYear+pause. Compare-only URL (?year=1200&compare=1900) rendered cleanly at 1,200 CE, likely because that particular test happened to hit React batch cleanly. Recommendation: initialize useTimeline with playing=false when URLSearchParams contain 'year' or 'event' or 'compare' (or call setYear/pause synchronously in useTimeline init via lazy initializer / read window.location.search once). Minor — feature still functional (event opens, params applied); only the displayed year is a few years off from the intended shareable value.

critical_code_review_comments: useTimeline hook does not honor URL params on init — this is why year-drift occurs on shareable URLs; consider lazy initial state that reads year from URLSearchParams.

SidePanel.jsx related_ids rendering assumes allEvents is populated when panel opens. When the URL directly opens an event on load, allEvents may still be empty for one render tick — the related buttons that resolve via allEvents.find can silently drop. Consider using events.length as a render gate for the lineage-graph section, or hydrate related_ids server-side with title+year already embedded.

rca_of_the_issue: Year-drift RCA: useTimeline.js hardcodes useState(TIMELINE_START) + useState(true) for playing. The RAF loop starts on mount, ticks year at 100 yps by default. Events fetch (~200-500ms) → then App parseURL effect fires setYear(URL_year) + pause(). Between the parse-effect firing and React committing the setPlaying(false) → cleanup, ~10 RAF frames can execute, each adding ~1.6 years. Fix: read URLSearchParams inside useTimeline lazy init so playing starts as false when year/event/compare params exist.
